execute_token_aligner: execute the token aligner plan to extract and stack aligned token tensors from a pair of step-mapped tensors
collapse_bs_to_t: collapse batch and sequence dimensions into a single flat token dimension using einops rearrange
build_bs_collapse_pattern: build einops lhs and rhs patterns with output dim names for collapsing batch-sequence dimensions
extract_and_stack_tokens: extract specific tokens from a tensor-of-step mapping using a locator and stack them along the token dimension
make_empty: create an empty tensor with the same shape and dtype as a source tensor but with zero tokens along the token dimension
